title: 5 high paying tech jobs that don't require coding

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know you can earn six figures without writing a single line of code?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tech is changing fast, and these jobs are booming right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: A tech product manager leads teams to build apps that millions use daily.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They work closely with engineers and designers to shape the user experience.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This role impacts how we shop, communicate, and even learn online.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Tech leadership roles are in high demand and well-paid.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s your dream tech job without coding? Let me know in the comments.
